set.descent_text: Descend the Southwest Ridge, the walk-up line on the mountain, to Moraine Lake. It is the quickest way down and is shared with hikers, so the party finishes on the Moraine Lake road rather than back at Paradise Valley; a shuttle or ride between the two ends saves time.
set.approach: From the Moraine Lake road, hike through Paradise Valley to Lake Annette below the north face. Leaving the lake, go south to the right-hand fin of the prominent Dolphin snowfield and follow the steepening snow couloir to its upper end, then traverse up and right to a second snow or ice field below steeper rock. That traverse is hazardous in lean snow because it crosses rotten rock without protection, so rope up before it. The route starts at a large chimney or gully above this upper snowfield.

review.notes: Both fields from the route page (single source); area page confirms the Moraine Lake road access. No distances or times written.
